name: svelte_hud_scale
description: The classic skin's interface groups at a phone-like window (1584x720) with hud_scale 1.8 (#448) and the touch top bar (#326): a hint over a scaled icon is a group stretched about the mouse, the bar's pause and escape plaques are the touch bar's text, and the groups are the same ones the plain bar has

steps.note: the anchor is the mouse in canvas pixels (window / 0.9375)
pause and escape glyphs: the touch bar has no resource values until its panel opens
